statement:
∀ (r : ℝ),
  IsOpen {p | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 < r} ∧
    IsClosed {p | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 ≤ r} ∧
      IsClosed {p | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 = r} ∧ (0 < r → ¬IsOpen {p | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 = r})
script:
# name: set-discs-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.OpenSets.discs_open_closed
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['1'], True, 'have key : ∀ (r : ℝ), IsOpen {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 < r} ∧ IsClosed {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 ≤ r} ∧ IsClosed {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 = r} ∧ (0 < r → ¬ IsOpen {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 = r}) := by
  intro r
  refine ⟨isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop), isClosed_le (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop),
    isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop), fun hr h => ?_⟩
  -- the point (√r, 0) is on the circle; the points (√r + t, 0) are not, for t > 0
  set s := Real.sqrt r
  have hs : s ^ 2 = r := Real.sq_sqrt hr.le
  have hs0 : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hr
  have hmem : ((s, 0) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 = r} := by simp [hs]
  have hn := h.mem_nhds hmem
  have hc : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => ((s + t, 0) : ℝ × ℝ)) (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (nhds (s, 0)) := by
    have : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => ((s + t, 0) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
    simpa using (this.tendsto 0).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  obtain ⟨t, ht, ht0⟩ := ((hc.eventually hn).and self_mem_nhdsWithin).exists
  simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_Ioi] at ht ht0
  nlinarith
exact @key (1)'),

    isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop), fun hr h => ?_⟩

  have hs0 : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hr
  have hmem : ((s, 0) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 = r} := by simp [hs]

    simpa using (this.tendsto 0).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  obtain ⟨t, ht, ht0⟩ := ((hc.eventually hn).and self_mem_nhdsWithin).exists
  simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_Ioi] at ht ht0
  nlinarith
exact @key (0)'),
    (['4'], False, 'have key : ∀ (r : ℝ), IsOpen {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 < r} ∧ IsClosed {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 ≤ r} ∧ IsClosed {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 = r} ∧ (0 < r → ¬ IsOpen {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 = r}) := by

    isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop), fun hr h => ?_⟩
  -- the point (√r, 0) is on the circle; the points (√r + t, 0) are not, for t > 0

  have hmem : ((s, 0) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 = r} := by simp [hs]
  have hn := h.mem_nhds hmem

    have : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => ((s + t, 0) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by fun_prop
